details: An unofficial republish of the baileys WhatsApp Web library, published under the unrelated scope @ruthless-imperium with the upstream vendor identity rewritten to "noxleyss"/"Calver". Installing it executes package/engine-requirements.js from the preinstall hook (a Node.js 20+ version gate), and requiring lib/index.js additionally clears the terminal, prints a branded banner, and spawns a child process running inline JavaScript (a spinner loop) via node -e. Its version check queries registry[.]npmjs[.]org for a package named "noxleyss" rather than the real upstream package, and library code uploads media unattended to public anonymous file hosts: catbox.moe, scdn.pdi.moe, qu.ax, uguu[.]se, tmpfiles[.]org and ezgif[.]com, with hardcoded links to levvicode[.]cloud embedded in message payloads. This version of the tree contains no environment or file exfiltration path and no remote-payload execution; WAProto/index.js and lib/WAM/constants.js are pure protocol/telemetry constant tables.
